### Important safety information

### Lingo

* * * *

The Lingo Glucose System is intended for users 18 years and older not on insulin. It is NOT intended
for diagnosis of diseases, including diabetes.

The Lingo program does not guarantee that everyone will achieve the same results as individual
responses may vary. Consult your healthcare professional before making changes to your diet or
exercise regime or if you have an eating disorder or a history of eating disorders.

The product images are representative only.

# We’re tackling the world’s toughest health challenges

[ Medicines & therapies ][166]
Johnson & Johnson Innovative Medicine is leading where medicine is going. Patients inform and
inspire our science-based innovations, which continue to change and save lives. With rigorous
science and compassion, we confidently address the most complex diseases of our time and unlock the
medicines of tomorrow. Healthcare areas include: Oncology, Immunology, Neuroscience and
Cardiopulmonary.

[ Medical devices & technology ][172]
Johnson & Johnson MedTech innovates at the intersection of biology and technology. With a focus on
treating with pinpoint precision in the hardest-to-reach parts of the body, restoring anatomy and
reimagining healing, our portfolio of smarter, less invasive, more personalized treatments is
addressing the most complex health challenges. Healthcare areas include: Cardiovascular,
Orthopaedics, Surgery and Vision.

leads to tendon healing without the need for sutured repair;^{1-4} offering patients a faster
recovery and return to activity than sutured repairs.^{4,5} ][13] [ [CARTIHEAL Procedure page Hero
Image.png] Chondral and osteochondral knee repair Treat knee cartilage lesions and osteochondral
defects in a single-stage procedure, even in the presence of mild to moderate osteoarthritis
(Kellgren-Lawrence 0-3),^{1,2} with the porous, biocompatible CARTIHEAL^{◊} AGILI-C^{◊} Cartilage
Repair Implant; shown to be clinically superior to the current surgical standard of care in level 1
clinical data.^{*1,2} ][14]

field. The success rate of the empaneled surgeons is in the top percentile in the country based on
the strong academic backgrounds and a robust experience in managing the complex treatments.

## Our Hospitals

While choosing a center for life saving surgery there are few factors that always play the most
vital role in the outcomes. One of the few factors is the post-operative care in the hospital.
Complex Treatments works with only JCI & NABH hospitals where post-op care is world class and no
corners are cut to ensure your loved one is taken care of.

family. Complex Treatments team works and exhibits four strong foundation pillars which we call
A.I.A- Awareness, Information & Access. Once we achieve the three steps the outcomes improve
significantly impacting the life span and quality of life for each patient.

### Better care.
### Better outcomes.

Novel medical devices for the endovascular repair of cerebral aneurysms.
[
watch video

[eCLIPs ]

# Aneurysm
# Remodelling
# DEVICES

Our products are innovative devices designed to treat 95% of cerebral aneurysms and are currently
targeted for use in challenging wide-neck bifurcations. eCLIPs effectively treats an aneurysm by
bridging the neck, creating flow effect, and providing scaffolding to enable endothelial growth.

[Close up shot of the eCLIPS medical device. ]

# NECK BRIDGING
* Deployment is as effective as the most deliverable neuro stent
* Full retractable & repositionable prior to detachment
* Non-migrating design prevents inadvertent movement of device
* One size serves a wide spectrum of aneurysm and neck sizes

[An illustration of the eCLIPS device treating an aneurysm. ]

# Unique Spine Rib Design
* Applicable to both bifurcations and sidewall aneurysms
* No need to enter the fragile aneurysm sac
* Ability to cross for coiling
* Non-shortening

[Illustration showing the size of the flow diverting leaf segment and the anchor segment. ]

# IDEAL FOR BIFURCATIONS

Bridges the neck, resulting in:
* Significant flow diversion
* Effective coil retention
* Mitigated water hammer effect
* Provides platform for endothelial growth

# EASE OF USE

# Efficacy

Wide necked bifurcation aneurysms (WNBA) are among the most difficult aneurysms to treat. Very low
dome-to-neck (DTN) and aspect ratios provide an even greater challenge in the management of WNBAs.
We present the safety and efficacy profile for endovascular clip system (eCLIPs) device in the
treatment of this subset of WNBAs with very unfavorable morphologies.

excellence.

#### Overview

### Designed to Deliver Excellence

Founded in 2015 in California, NeuroVasc Technologies brings over 100 years of combined expertise in
neurovascular device design and development. We are committed to being the most efficient and
innovative developer of neurovascular treatment devices in the world.

NeuroVasc is focused on developing a portfolio of novel catheter-based technologies to facilitate
broad treatment options for patients suffering stroke and other neurovascular diseases.

## Worldwide Distribution

Since its founding in 2015, NeuroVasc has been dedicated to developing innovative and breakthrough
solutions for the treatment of neurovascular diseases.

We currently have clearance to serve patients in more than 35 countries, and our technologies are

#### Overview

### Designed to Deliver Excellence

Founded in 2015 in California, NeuroVasc Technologies brings over 100 years of combined expertise in
neurovascular device design and development. We are committed to being the most efficient and
innovative developer of neurovascular treatment devices in the world.

NeuroVasc is focused on developing a portfolio of novel catheter-based technologies to facilitate
broad treatment options for patients suffering stroke and other neurovascular diseases.

# Design, Development & Manufacturing of Medical Devices

OxDevice provide a wide range of services to assist in the development of medical devices,
manufacturing and associated testing.

[Learn More][20]
[Contact Us][21]

## What we do

## Unique product design & development

At OxDevice we are passionate about designing, developing, and manufacturing medical devices. We
support companies to achieve their goals in launching a new product or concept through a unique
product [**design and development process**][22].

We understand that great ideas and design are only the start of the journey, and our vision is to
deliver low cost, reliability, and product longevity. We are proud of our unique expertise and can
offer an enviable portfolio of high-quality holistic services:
* Medical Device Development
* Endovascular and neurovascular device experts
* Medical sensor development
* Clean-room manufacturing
* Consultancy Services
* Medical electronics
* Start-up and university spin-out specialists
* Testing services
* Medical device coating services

## Why choose us

## Safe, reliable & cost effective

At OxDevice we live and breathe **medical devices**, so we understand what a huge commitment a new
product development is. We’ve designed and developed for a wide range of businesses and our ambition
is to ensure that we deliver on every project with success.

We have over 50 years of combined deep experience developing medical devices and we fully understand
the complexities of product design and importantly, how to manufacture them safely, reliably and
cost effectively.

We operate a Quality Management System certified to EN ISO 13485:2016 for both design and
development services and manufacturing.

### ABOUT OUR COMPANY

## OxDevice Medical delivers product design and development solutions that are innovative,
## practical, and commercially successful.

### Facilities & Equipment

We build long term relationships with our clients by providing them with innovative design and
development solutions.

[Learn more][23]

We are fully committed to best practice in medical design and development and operate a full-scope
system including both design and manufacturing.

## SOLUTIONS

# INNOVATIONS IN CARING

### TERUMO INTERVENTIONAL SYSTEMS (TIS)

TIS is a market leader in providing solutions that enable minimally invasive entry site management,
lesion access and therapeutic intervention for cardiology, peripheral arterial disease,
embolotherapy and interventional oncology.
